questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code designs the REST resource and its responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A file "report.csv" already exists. A client sends PUT to it with a new body and no conditional headers. What is returned?
choices: 201 Created, because PUT always creates a new version
428 Precondition Required, and the stored file is left unchanged
412 Precondition Failed because no ETag was supplied

questions.prompt: Two clients both read the file with ETag "v1" and both send PUT with If-Match "v1" at the same moment. What is the result?
choices: Both succeed; the later write wins
Exactly one succeeds with 200; the other is rejected with 412 because the stored ETag has changed
Exactly one succeeds; the other receives 409

questions.prompt: A client calls GET .../files/report.csv with If-None-Match set to the current ETag. What does it receive?
choices: 200 with the full body, since If-None-Match only applies to PUT
404 because the ETag header is treated as a version selector
304 Not Modified with no body and the ETag header
